Measure net-new non-test lines, or keep the file count as the bound - it held in all 24 cards across both rounds and was what actually caught sprawl. The builder then kept them, and its own case-7 wording ("the ONLY predicate") would have let it drop the absolute kill switch had the critic not flagged it. The method tells the scout to pick a gate and the critic to check floors; it does not tell the coordinator to interrogate a borderline gate, and that interrogation was the highest-value thing I did this round. (2) VERIFY THE CARD'S COUNTS MYSELF BEFORE WRITING A BRIEF. I did it this time (the "3 hits, zero tests" claim was false - five hits, two in tests, driving >=6 tests of which four assert healthy:true through that flag) and the correction STRENGTHENED the card and produced a real build consequence.
